commentary: Despite headline index gains reclaiming 22,800 on Fed rate stability, overall Indian market breadth remains subdued with a breadth score of 38 and an active WEAK deterministic gate. Stan Weinstein and William O'Neil established that the general market trend dictates the outcome of three out of four equities. Elevated crude prices and distribution days advise defensive capital allocation. In this tape, professional traders utilize progressive exposure—concentrating exposure solely on Stage 2 institutional leaders demonstrating CANSLIM-grade accelerating EPS and triple-digit volume expansion, while sidestepping false breakouts, base churn, and decelerating fundamentals.

Price levels are scanner references, not live quotes.

analysis.analyst: Minervini SEPA, O'Neil CANSLIM, Weinstein Stage Analysis & Livermore Discipline

63MOONS.technical: Price holds above the 21 EMA, 50 SMA, and 200 SMA, testing the 958.91 double bottom pivot. RSI at 69 confirms constructive momentum without acute extension, but volume confirmation through the neckline remains required to confirm institutional absorption.
63MOONS.fundamental: Consolidated financials show historical volatility and high reliance on other income. Without verified, consecutive quarters of CANSLIM-qualifying bottom-line expansion exceeding 25%, institutional accumulation remains speculative under O'Neil criteria.
63MOONS.risk: A breakdown below swing low support at 851.71 invalidates the base structure; exit immediately to preserve capital.

AAATECH.technical: Constructing a double bottom pattern above major moving averages toward the 119.12 trigger. RSI at 59 reflects mild upside traction on 1.22x volume, but relative strength significantly lags true Stage 2 market leaders.
AAATECH.fundamental: Q1 FY27 sales dropped 11% YoY with net profit up a modest 6%. Sub-10% ROCE and lack of top-line velocity disqualify it from CANSLIM leadership, failing institutional sponsorship standards.
AAATECH.risk: Thesis fails on a breach below 100.75 support; maintain strict stop discipline to avoid dead-money lockup in base chop.

AAREYDRUGS.technical: Price poked above the pivot then closed back underneath, triggering Livermore's classic danger signal. Although trading above key moving averages, this rejection demonstrates heavy overhead supply and institutional distribution.
AAREYDRUGS.fundamental: Latest Q1 FY27 results revealed a severe 56% YoY contraction in sales and a 26% decline in net profit. Return metrics remain weak with ROCE at 5.6%, completely breaching CANSLIM fundamentals.
AAREYDRUGS.risk: Failed breakout demands immediate defensive action; violation below 103.84 confirms distribution and risks a Stage 4 decline.

AARTIPHARM.technical: Textbook Stage 2 posture above rising 50, 150, and 200-day moving averages. Price action displays a constructive three-up sequence off a 21-EMA and 50-DMA pullback, applying sustained pressure on the 1003.40 neckline pivot.
AARTIPHARM.fundamental: Q1 FY27 net profit jumped 54% YoY driven by 39% revenue growth, meeting O'Neil's CANSLIM C-criterion. Expanding CDMO capacities and high-margin API intermediate operations support healthy cash generation.
AARTIPHARM.risk: A drop below the 921.87 support shelf invalidates the double bottom structure; enforce Minervini's progressive stop discipline.

ACMESOLAR.technical: Demonstrating high relative strength in Stage 2 above rising 50, 150, and 200 SMAs. The stock is challenging a double bottom pivot at 477.38 on 2.21x volume expansion, validating authentic institutional demand.
ACMESOLAR.fundamental: Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT surged 133% YoY on 90% revenue expansion, building upon Q1's 80% earnings growth. Exceptional 85%+ operating margins in utility solar and battery storage reflect prime institutional sponsorship.
ACMESOLAR.risk: Breakdown below the 437.85 swing floor negates the pivot advance; cut losses fast to avoid bull traps.

ACUTAAS.technical: Displays classic SEPA breakout traits, clearing a 20-session high into fresh 52-week highs on overwhelming 12.17x volume expansion. Top-tier relative strength and Darvas box continuation mark decisive institutional accumulation.
ACUTAAS.fundamental: Q2 FY27 PAT jumped 71% YoY on 43% revenue expansion, with EBITDA margins surging to 40.3%. Superior ROCE of 33% and high-purity semiconductor chemical expansion provide stellar CANSLIM credentials.
ACUTAAS.risk: A close back beneath the 3198.22 breakout base invalidates institutional sponsorship; cut loss immediately without hesitation.
